Peninsular Campaign, 1862
description: General McClellan and the Army of the Potomac -- Campaign plans -- Active operations: Siege of Yorktown -- Forward from Yorktown: Battle of Williamsburg -- To the Chickahominy: McDowell ; Jackson in the Shenandoah Valley ; Affair of Hanover Court House -- Battle of Fair Oaks -- Withdrawal to the James: the Seven Days' Battle -- Battle of Malvern Hill -- Termination of the Campaign -- Appendix A: Troops of the Army of the Potomac sent to the Peninsula in March and April, 1862 -- Appendix B: Organization of the Army of Northern Virginia during engagements around Richmond, Va
